run_f_gold: run f_gold to count ordered pairs where bitwise AND of two elements equals zero
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct pair counting results
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the O(n^2) nested loop approach for counting zero-AND pairs
review_f_gold: review f_gold which iterates over all pairs checking if their bitwise AND equals zero
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that counts ordered pairs (i,j) where a[i] AND a[j] equals zero
